articles.headline: Have England's performances raised doubts over their World Cup hopes?
World Cup Daily LIVE: Colombia-Portugal kick off, England win Group L
articles.description: It's the final day of World Cup action from the group stages, as Portugal's Cristiano Ronaldo and Argentina's Lionel Messi (maybe) could play on the same day.

articles.headline: Croatia edge Ghana to clinch spot in World Cup knockouts
articles.description: Croatia earned a spot in the World Cup knockout round, getting goals from Nikola Vlasic and Luka Sucic to beat Ghana 2-1 on Saturday.

articles.headline: Jude Bellingham, Harry Kane strike again as England beat Panama, top group
articles.description: Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane scored early in the second half, lifting England over Panama 2-0 Saturday and into what appears to be a more favorable bracket for the knockout phase of the World Cup.

articles.headline: Who scored the most goals in men's World Cup history?
articles.description: Argentina's Lionel Messi scored the most goals in men's World Cup history. Check out which other soccer stars made the list.

articles.headline: Scotland eliminated from World Cup as they fall short of knockout stage again
articles.description: Scotland have been eliminated from the World Cup after failing to progress as one of the best performing third-placed teams.
